prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 异常长值 · 标签列中的一个长值 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "城市" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 230px
  col 2: header "级别" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 368px
  col 3: header "人口（万）" · longest unbreakable word 46px · one-line width 77px
  col 4: header "备注" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 200px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"按城市列出级别、人口和备注，便于比较各城市，并呈现一条名称和级别描述都异常长的记录。","reading":"读者先按城市定位行，再横向读取级别、人口和备注；比较人口时需要沿数值列向下扫描。长记录产生的行高可同时容纳该行其他单元格换行。","groups":["城市与级别共同标识和描述每条记录，适合相邻阅读。","人口是可纵向比较的数值；备注是补充说明，两列承担不同角色，但都需要与同一行的城市对应。"],"keep_intact":["人口数值及其数字序列","城市和级别名称的完整内容，换行时不截断或省略"],"may_wrap":["异常长的城市名称可在汉字之间换行","长级别描述可换行，并利用长城市名称形成的行高","备注可自然换行","空间紧张时，人口列标题可换行"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [90, 105, 98, 66] · table 360×418px · row heights [36, 36, 60, 36, 36, 176, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [85, 95, 98, 81] · table 360×418px · row heights [36, 36, 60, 36, 36, 176, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [90, 105, 83, 81] · table 360×394px · row heights [60, 36, 60, 36, 36, 129, 36] · column headers wrapped 1/4 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"四个标题保持单行，人口数字便于纵向比较；城市与级别相邻，普通记录容易横向阅读。","problems":"长记录过高，备注被切成许多短行；上海的备注也换成两行，行高因此增加。","cause":"备注列仅66px，扣除内边距后文字空间约45px；人口列98px则为保持标题单行占用了较多宽度。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"备注比r1A宽，长记录的补充说明更容易阅读；人口标题与数字仍完整。","problems":"长记录仍有七行高，级别描述切得较碎，末尾孤立的“化）”尤其不顺；城市名称也较拥挤。","cause":"级别列从105px缩至95px，而人口列仍为98px；增加备注宽度没有缩短由级别列决定的长行。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"人口标题换行换来了更宽的备注列，长记录降至五行，城市、级别和备注之间的比例比前两版更均衡。人口数字仍保持完整。","problems":"标题行因人口标题换行而明显增高；上海备注仍换行，长记录的级别和备注仍切成较短的片段。","cause":"人口列83px不足以容纳单行标题；备注列81px的文字空间不足以完整放下“经济中心”，级别列105px也限制了长描述的每行长度。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r2A","widths":[90,120,75,74],"change":"以r1C为基础，将人口列缩至足以容纳最长数字的75px，把主要空间给级别列；接受人口标题换行，观察长描述能否更自然地分行。"},{"name":"r2B","widths":[95,115,70,79],"change":"在人口数字仍可完整显示的前提下，进一步压缩人口列，并在城市和级别之间分配空间；检验长城市名与长级别描述能否形成更均衡的行高。"},{"name":"r2C","widths":[90,105,67,97],"change":"尝试优先保证备注可读性：将人口列压至恰好容纳最长数字的宽度，把节省的空间给备注，观察上海备注及长备注的换行是否改善。"}]}
